about: One becomes 64 in six splits: structure short 3, a loop of about 10 s (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). The Leibniz lesson's doubling tree (Diagram.tsx 'tree'), alone. Queued overnight 2026-10-01 (the user: 'please queue up a few more shorts'). hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 90 bpm, A# major, from 0 s as on 2, 15 and 36; no other structure short uses it

caption: The I Ching has 64 six-line patterns, with each line broken or solid. Read the book for judgment at sixlines.day.

pages.q: WHY 64 PATTERNS IN THE I CHING
pages.a:
THE BOOK USES SIX-LINE PATTERNS.
EACH LINE: BROKEN OR SOLID.
ADD A LINE. DOUBLE THE COUNT.
2 → 4 → 8 → 16 → 32 → 64.
